name: Replanting & Rejuvenation of Coconut Garden" by the Coconut Development Board
benefit: - **Cutting & Removal** @ ₹ 1,000/‐ per palm subject to a maximum of ₹ 32,000/ per hectare.  - **Assistance for Replanting** @ ₹ 40 per seedling subject to a maximum of ₹ 4,000.- **Integrated Management Practices** @ ₹ 17,500/‐ per hectare in two annual installments, for upto 4 hectares per farmer.- Seasonality: Annually.
_eligibility_text: All categories of coconut farmers with farmer's identity cards/ authenticated land records/documents are eligible.
